qualityCheckDefinitions.wordWindowDifference: Difference between independent forced-alignment windows; model agreement alone is not a measurement of lyric timing error.
qualityCheckDefinitions.scoreRepeatDifference: Difference between the independently matched score system and its median position across repeated verses; not a measurement of lyric timing error.
qualityCheckDefinitions.bodyFitResidual: Residual of music-to-music time mapping, not lyric boundary error.

notes: Every cue was sought on both recordings in all three viewports.
Additional image geometry checks waited for the complete 1.2-second rejoin animation before measuring visibility.
Browser checks verify playback, data integration and layout; they do not replace human listening review.
